import cv2, numpy as np
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
base='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724_arrow_removed_opencv_base.png'
sobel='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_upper_right_724x724_arrow_removed_sobel_x.png'
a=cv2.imread(base,cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
s=cv2.imread(sobel,cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
assert a.shape==s.shape==(724,724)
blur=cv2.GaussianBlur(a,(0,0),2.1)
lap=cv2.GaussianBlur(a,(0,0),4.5)
def samples(arr,theta):
 r=np.arange(620,723.5,.5,dtype=np.float32)
 rad=np.deg2rad(theta)
 x=r*np.sin(rad)
 y=724-r*np.cos(rad)
 vals=cv2.remap(arr,x.reshape(1,-1),y.reshape(1,-1),cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,borderValue=255).reshape(-1)
 return r,vals
print('PIXEL_ORIGIN',(0,724),'IMAGE',(724,724),'cv2',cv2.__version__)
for th in (0,2,5,10,15,22.5,30,37.5,45,52.5,60,67.5,75,82.5,85,88,89):
 r,v=samples(lap,th)
 dr=np.gradient(v,r)
 ix=int(np.argmax(dr[(r>660)&(r<719)]))
 opts=np.flatnonzero((r>660)&(r<719))
 k=opts[ix]
 peak_ids,_=find_peaks(dr,prominence=1.3,distance=6)
 tops=sorted([(round(float(dr[i]),2),round(float(r[i]),2)) for i in peak_ids if r[i]>660],reverse=True)[:5]
 idx=[int(np.argmin(abs(r-rr))) for rr in (660,670,680,690,695,700,705,710,715,720)]
 print('ANGLE',th,'OUTER_MAX_GRAD',round(float(r[k]),2),'DY',round(float(dr[k]),2),'TOP_GRADIENT_PEAKS',tops,'RADIAL_INTENSITIES',[(float(r[i]),round(float(v[i]),1)) for i in idx])
